sources_consulted.found: Lent 1915 translated the LONGER Bedjan recension (B.M. Add. 14484), not the Vatican shorter recension. Two independent recensions confirmed: Bedjan (longer) and Assemani/Vatican Syr. 160 (shorter). Neither derives from the other.
Vat. Syr. 160 confirmed as containing the shorter Assemani recension; produced 473 AD by Simeon of Marimîn and archdeacon Cyrus at Telneshe.
Doran 1992 Cistercian Studies 112 includes the Syriac Life alongside Theodoret and Antonius vitae.
Doran Syriac Life translation is based on the Vatican manuscript (dated 473 AD) using Assemani edition as source text.
All three lives translated into English by Doran; Syriac life also by Lent. Syriac source dates to 473 (= Vat. Syr. 160).

reasoning: Vat. Syr. 160 holds the SHORTER Assemani recension of the Syriac Life. Lent 1915 translated the LONGER Bedjan recension (different text, NOT a prior). Doran 1992 (Cistercian Studies 112) explicitly translated from the Vatican manuscript / Assemani edition — the same shorter recension in our codex. Complete modern English prior confirmed via Doran. Stage-1 claim about Lent is wrong recension, but Doran is valid; demote stands.
